While combat can be played with solely a mouse or keyboard, it's best played with a combination of keyboard (arrow keys to move) and mouse (right click to attack). Key bindings can be changed from the settings menu (e.g. WASD movement).
\I[1247] Teddy Bear bombs and \I[508] Antiandrogen either drop from chests or can be purchased from the nurse in Harfort, and can be used during combat.
While you advance in the Hole, the enemies will get stronger and loot will get better.
Your romance level with the girls can be viewed on the Contacts page from the phone menu.

You can increase your romance level by doing their daily tasks, completing objectives or by gifting them presents. Keep in mind that the girls have different tastes, so try to figure out what present they would like before buying gifts for them from the gift shop in town.

Objectives can be accessed from the phone menu, and are quests that can either be attained by advancing the days (by sleeping) or by talking to NPC's with a blue or orange question mark on top of their heads.

Side quests are not necessary to complete to advance the main story, while main quests are necessary to advance the main story.

Using your arrow keys on the objectives page, you can change the quest filter:

\C[1]All:\C[0] all active quests
\C[18]Failed:\C[0] quests that you failed to complete

If you're stuck progressing through the game, try completing your objectives first. The best way to find new objectives is to interact with a girl and select \I[4] talk.
